# Tabitha Pratt

## Overview

- **Age:** Aged  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** The Glen  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052)</sub>
- **Role:** General servant  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052)</sub>

## Appearance

Tabitha is an aged, stern-visaged woman. She resembles a severe yet kindly protective angel when attending to those she cares for.

_Sources: [v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c24 P0](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0000)_

## Personality

Tabitha is good-natured and intensely loyal to her employer, displaying an unreasoning devotion. Though she has a severe demeanor, she holds a kindly, protective nature toward her friends. She is confident in her culinary abilities, holds no ill will toward men, and lacks affection for felines.

_Sources: [v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P41](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0041), [v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), [v4 c24 P0](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0000), [v4 c40 P5](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0005)_

- Good-natured  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052)</sub>

## Abilities

- Culinary skills  <sub>[v4 c19 P41](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0041), [v4 c24 P0](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0000)</sub>

## History

Tabitha Pratt lived as an unwed woman from the Glen. She was hired as a general servant at the small residence of Dr. Carrow and his wife Nell. After visiting a sick person in the Glen, she returned to her duties and grew deeply devoted to Nell, affectionately referring to her as "young Mrs. Doctor." Though initially suspicious of Thirza Abernethy's arrival, she accepted her once she saw Thirza did not interfere with her kitchen duties or her care of Nell. She took pride in her cooking, competing in mind with Miss Tolley, and assisted Nell in hosting social gatherings. She also endured the presence of the First Mate, a pet cat, despite having little affection for felines.

_Sources: [v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P41](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0041), [v4 c24 P0](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0000), [v4 c26 P0](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0000), [v4 c40 P5](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0005)_

## Background by volume

- Never courted or proposed to by any man  <sub>[v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005)</sub>
- Remained an unmarried old maid  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005)</sub>

## Quotes

> An old maid I may be, yet you do not catch ME speaking ill of men. They suit me fine. Had the opportunity arisen, I would gladly have wed one. Mrs. Doctor, dear, isn't it peculiar that not a single man ever proposed marriage to me? Although I lack exceptional beauty, my appearance matches that of the majority of wives around us. Yet no man ever courted me. Why do you imagine that was?  <sub>[v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005)</sub>

> Oh, yes, here I am, Mrs. Doctor, dear, and blowing like a hen pulling rails at that! Coming down here from the Glen is quite a walk.  <sub>[v4 c38 P35](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0035)</sub>

> I cannot entirely follow your meaning, Mrs. Doctor, dear, though naturally my education is lacking. However, should Dr. Carrow purchase the Varley property, it will certainly be a sound decision, you can rely on that. Running water is installed there, the pantries and closets are delightful, and I have heard that no other cellar on St. Brendan’s Island compares to it. Indeed, the cellar in this house, Mrs. Doctor, dear, has caused me great sorrow, as you are well aware.  <sub>[v4 c40 P47](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0047)</sub>
